scripts.build: npm run build -w @bumpshift/shared && npm run build -w @bumpshift/server && npm run build -w @bumpshift/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke:multiplayer
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bumpshift/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names server,client --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @bumpshift/server" "npm run dev -w @bumpshift/client"
